title: N6. Updates: decided by you
summary: You ruled: the app downloads each update in the background and restarts when you click the banner.

children.prompt: Confirm your ruling as written: an update is saved without a click and shown in the banner; nothing restarts until you click; below the minimum version the forced update stays.
pros: It restores the click-to-update flow; the banner is still in the app.
cons: A laptop that stays busy after the click shows Updating until every note is between edits.
